newsitem.title: USA: Fed adds rerserves via 3-day fixed system RPs.
newsitem.headline: Fed adds rerserves via 3-day fixed system RPs.

text.p: The Federal Reserve added reserves into the banking system on Monday via three-day system repurchase agreements, a New York Fed spokeswoman said.
The RPs were for fixed collateral.
The operation was expected, given the Fed is seen facing a $1.5 billion add need left for the remainder of the maintenance period, which ends on Wednesday.
The Fed stayed out of the open market on Friday. Federal funds were trading at the Fed's 5-1/4 percent target rate at the time of the intervention.
